name: agentid
_doc: AgentID verifier_attestation (CTEF v0.1): off-chain issuer-signed, recomputable, no anchor claimed; ordering and sequence integrity are the board's layer. Issuer key kid agentid-2026-03 (OKP/Ed25519) resolves from https://getagentid.dev/.well-known/jwks.json and is the verificationMethod of did:web:getagentid.dev. envelope_hash = response.digest = SHA-256(JCS(core)), core = response minus {digest, jws}; the compact JWS payload IS JCS(core) and the EdDSA signature covers BASE64URL(protected).BASE64URL(payload). The live response carries no hex pubkey / canonical_bytes field and a COMPACT JWS, so this adapter reads the saved fixture (agentid.fixtures/positive.json), which embeds the verbatim response under verifier_attestation plus a governance block and an RFC 7515 general-serialization re-encoding of the same JWS -- see agentid.fixtures/build_fixtures.py and verify_fixture.py.

_fetch.note: how agentid.fixtures/positive.raw.json was obtained (public endpoint, no credential). Kept as _fetch (not executed) because the live shape lacks verifier_pubkey / canonical_bytes_utf8 and carries a compact JWS, which live_check cannot read without the re-encoding in positive.json.
